question.text: Per SEBI guidance, for trades executed on Monday (T), on which day should clients submit settlement instructions?

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI has advised clients to submit settlement instructions on T+1. For trades executed on Monday, instructions are submitted on Tuesday. The Trap: Confusing submission of settlement instructions with pay-in day — for a Monday trade, the source example gives pay-in as Wednesday. Note: Physical instructions can be submitted up to 4 p.m. and electronic instructions up to 6 p.m. on the submission day.
